summary:
家得寶EPS超預期7.8%，獲利優於預估顯示成本管理與專業客群業務韌性。
• EPS 2.72美元，超出預期2.52美元，超預期幅度7.80%
• 營收382.0億美元，反映淡季仍具規模支撑
• 成本控管與專業承包商業務貢獻獲利韌性
• 穩定現金流支撑股息成長與回購
ai_view:
訊號正面：近8%的EPS超預期顯示家得寶成本管理得宜、專業客群業務具韌性，獲利優於市場預估。短期對股價偏多，惟營收年增率未揭露使需求趨勢判讀有限。中期關鍵在房市與利率回穩能否帶動裝修需求復甦。追蹤指標：同店銷售、客單價與來客數、Pro業務占比、毛利率、庫存周轉與全年指引。

需留意：營收年增率未揭露，需求趨勢方向待確認；高利率持續壓抑大型房屋裝修專案；可選消費疲弱與房市交投低迷的循環風險

summary_en:
Home Depot beat EPS by 7.8%, with earnings ahead of estimates reflecting cost control and Pro-segment resilience.
• EPS of $2.72 beat the $2.52 estimate by 7.80%
• Revenue of $38.20B shows scale support even in the off-season
• Cost control and the Pro contractor business drive earnings resilience
• Stable cash flow supports dividend growth and buybacks

ai_view_en:
Signal is positive: a ~8% EPS beat shows Home Depot's cost management and Pro-segment resilience, with earnings ahead of estimates. Near-term bullish for the stock, though undisclosed YoY limits demand-trend reads. Mid-term the key is whether stabilizing housing and rates revive remodeling demand. Track: comparable-store sales, ticket and traffic, Pro mix, gross margin, inventory turnover and full-year guidance.

Watch：Revenue YoY not disclosed, so the demand trend needs confirmation; Sustained high rates continue to suppress large remodeling projects; Cyclical risk from weak discretionary spending and sluggish housing turnover
beat_or_miss: 超預期 / EPS超預期7.80%，獲利優於預估（營收年增率未揭露）。
